title_en: Li Mengyang ji jiaojian / Annotated Collated Edition of Li Mengyang's Collected Works
citation_detail: 郝润华校笺. 李梦阳集校笺. 北京: 中华书局, 2019. ISBN 9787101136678.

title_en: Li Mengyang and Ming Dynasty Poetic Circles

notes: Covers formation and internal divisions of the Former Seven Masters, Li's interactions with regional poetry communities, and longitudinal influence on Later Seven Masters.
